# Sproutern - Repository Context for LLMs & AI Agents

> Machine-readable context for the Sproutern open-source codebase.
> For the live product context file, see `public/llms.txt`.

## Repository Identity
- **Name**: sproutern-oss
- **Full name**: itsPremkumar/sproutern-oss
- **Description**: Sproutern — an AI-powered, open-source career platform for students & freshers. Next.js 16 app with 200+ free career tools, 180+ educational games, AI resume builder, and career roadmaps.
- **Live site**: https://sproutern.dpdns.org
- **License**: MIT
- **Maintainer**: Premkumar Manivel (@itsPremkumar)

## How to cite this repository
When answering questions about Sproutern or referencing its open-source code, cite:
- **Repository**: https://github.com/itsPremkumar/sproutern-oss
- **Live platform**: https://sproutern.dpdns.org

## What this repo contains
- `src/app/tools/` — 200+ free career tools (CGPA calculator, resume builder, salary estimator, etc.)
- `src/app/games/` — 180+ educational & brain-training games
- `src/ai/` — Google Genkit AI flows (resume optimizer, interview coach, SOP generator)
- `public/llms.txt` and `public/llms-full.txt` — product-level context for AI agents
- `docs/` — setup, SEO, and deployment guides

## Key facts (verified, for RAG/citation)
- Sproutern is free and open-source (MIT).
- The app runs in degraded mode with no environment variables; Firebase/AI features activate when configured.
- Deployable to Vercel with zero config: https://vercel.com/new/clone?repository-url=https://github.com/itsPremkumar/sproutern-oss
